description: Fetch Project Gutenberg metadata by book ID: titles, author names and aliases, translators, editors, contributor credits, edition notes, release date, imprint, reading ease, table of contents, subjects, classification, and available formats. Use is_readable before gutenberg_get_text.

id.description: Project Gutenberg book ID. Visible in Gutenberg URLs (e.g., gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342) and returned by gutenberg_search_books and gutenberg_browse_popular. Example: 1342 for Pride and Prejudice, 2600 for War and Peace.

name: gutenberg_get_book

alternative_titles.description: Alternative titles in catalog order. [] means none in the RDF; null means unavailable.

aliases.description: Catalog aliases in order. [] means none in the RDF; null means unavailable.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown or still living.

webpage.description: English Wikipedia page supplied by the catalog, or null.

bookshelves.description: Project Gutenberg bookshelf categories (e.g., "Best Books Ever Listings", "Category: Classics of Literature").

catalogAsOf.description: Last recorded bulk RDF archive checkpoint, or null when unavailable or inapplicable.

catalogSource.description: Catalog that answered: local mirror or per-book RDF.

contents.description: Catalog table of contents with source line breaks, or null if unavailable.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown or still living.

role.description: MARC relator label, or the catalog code when unmapped.

contributors.description: Source credits beyond authors, editors and translators. [] means none in the RDF; null means unavailable.

copyright.description: Copyright status: false = public domain in the USA, true = under copyright, null = unknown.

download_count.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot, used for popularity ranking.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No book exists with the given ID. `catalog_unavailable`: The Project Gutenberg catalog did not answer, or returned an unreadable record, within the time this server allows for one lookup. `catalog_rejected`: The Project Gutenberg catalog refused the lookup outright rather than failing temporarily. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

formats.description: Map of MIME type to download URL. Key types: "text/plain; charset=utf-8" (preferred for gutenberg_get_text), "text/html", "application/epub+zip", "image/jpeg" (cover). Not every format is present for every book.

has_plain_text.description: True if media_type is "Text" and "text/plain; charset=utf-8" is present. HTML-only editions can still have is_readable=true.

is_readable.description: Eligible Text record with UTF-8 plain text, or HTML without audio formats. Does not guarantee the mirror file exists.

languages.description: Catalog language codes for this edition.

lcc.description: Library of Congress Classification codes. [] means none in the RDF; null means unavailable.

media_type.description: Source media type, such as "Text" or "Sound" (audio). Use is_readable to check reader support.

reading_ease.description: Catalog reading-ease note, or null if unavailable.

release_date.description: Project Gutenberg ebook release date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if unavailable.

source_imprint.description: Catalog imprint statement, or null if unavailable.

source_notes.description: Source-provided RDF bibliographic notes in document order, including explicit edition references. [] means inspected with no notes; null means unavailable from this source.

summaries.description: Every source-provided summary, sorted. Empty when there are none.

summary.description: First entry of summaries, not necessarily primary, or null when the source has none.

translators.description: Translators, if this is a translated work.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown.

title: Get Gutenberg Book
